fields.name: vptr
fields.evidence: constructor inlined in the boma builders (0x7100573780, 0x71006882d0, 0x71033b97b0); destructors 0x71003d1780 / 0x71003d17e0 rewrite it

fields.name: owner_boma
fields.how: plain load; written only by the constructor
fields.evidence: constructor stores the owner accessor next to the vptr; is_generatable (slot 0x1d8) loads it and re-enters the module through its +0x98; generate (slot 0x70) uses it as default owner when the caller passes null

fields.name: active_list.vptr
fields.how: embedded ring container of live articles; vptr 0x7104f6a4c8 (destructor swaps to base 0x7104f6a4f8)

fields.name: active_list.capacity
fields.evidence: every ring walk (get_num, is_exist, get_article, motion_kind, remove...) computes index = (head+i) % this

fields.name: active_list.count
fields.how: number of live articles in the ring; walks iterate i < count
fields.evidence: loop bound of is_exist/get_num/get_article; ring-remove helper 0x71003d73a0 decrements it; slot 0x48 (clear) zeroes it; slot 0x1a0 appends and increments

fields.name: active_list.head
fields.how: ring index of the oldest entry
fields.evidence: ring walks start at (head+i)%cap; removing the front advances it modulo capacity; clear zeroes it

fields.name: active_list.tail
fields.how: ring index of the newest entry
fields.evidence: ring-remove helper moves it back one modulo capacity when the last entry goes; clear zeroes it

fields.name: active_list.data
fields.evidence: constructor stores this+0x40; every ring walk loads it

fields.name: active_list.storage
fields.how: 64 inline Article pointers; entry +0x10 is the article kind
fields.evidence: ring walks load data[(head+i)%64] and compare entry+0x10 with the kind argument

fields.name: article_pool
fields.how: 0x238-byte pool object (vptr 0x7104f626e8) allocated by the constructor, freed by the destructor
fields.evidence: constructor allocates 0x238 bytes and stores it; get_active_num / is_generatable / generate (slot 0x70) / clear read its descriptor table and slots; slot 0x30 initialises it via 0x71003a6270

fields.name: external_article_holder
fields.how: 0 at construction; set by vtable slot 0x228 (no export); slot 0x230 writes a bool into its +0x258
fields.evidence: every kind lookup (generate slot 0x70, is_generatable, get_active_num, slots 0x1e8 and 0x280) compares the kind with the own descriptor count and, when beyond it, uses this object instead (own pool at +0x240, descriptor table at +0x260 or +0x238->+0x8; helper 0x71003a5c20 counts its live articles); clear (slot 0x48) also clears its pool

fields.name: generate_item_pos
fields.how: set_generate_item_pos stores x,y,z with w forced to 0; vtable slot 0x270 (not exported) returns it by a plain 128-bit load
fields.evidence: set_generate_item_pos slot 0x278 = 0x71003d7160 stores; slot 0x270 = 0x71003d7150 loads; constructor copies 16 bytes from the vector pointed to by the global 0x71052a8a88 (a default vector, probably zero)

fields.name: (derived) get_num
fields.how: computed: count of ring entries whose kind == arg

fields.name: (derived) is_exist
fields.how: computed: any ring entry with kind == arg

fields.name: (derived) get_article
fields.how: computed: first (oldest) ring entry with kind == arg, else null

fields.name: (derived) get_article_from_no
fields.how: computed: no-th ring entry (oldest first) with kind == arg, else null

fields.name: (derived) get_active_num
fields.how: computed: over the pool slots reserved for the kind (start = sum of max_num of earlier kinds, length = max_num of the kind) count those whose virtual slot 0xd0 says active; kinds beyond the own table go to the external holder

fields.name: (derived) is_generatable
fields.how: computed: compares max_num(kind) with the current count (live pool slots, or a global weapon count when descriptor flag bit1 is set)

pointers.to: Article (embedded at +0x68 of its weapon object): +0x0 vptr, +0x8 the article's own BattleObjectModuleAccessor (its +0x88 MotionModule and +0x38 PostureModule are used by motion_kind / set_pos), +0x10 article kind (u32), +0x18 and +0x20 two intrusive ref-counted handles (u16 count at +0x8) released when the article leaves the ring

ArticlePool (vptr 0x7104f626e8, 0x238 bytes): +0x8 capacity 64, +0x10 slot count, +0x18 data -> +0x20, +0x20..+0x220 64 Article* slots grouped by kind, +0x220 u32 number of own kinds (descriptors before the first with flag bit0), +0x228 descriptor table {ptr to 32-byte entries, u32 count at +0x8}; entry +0x0 u32 weapon kind, +0x4 i32 max_num, +0x18 u8 flags (bit0 end of own kinds, bit1 count globally); +0x230 u32 (init -1, then from the setup block +0x118; passed when creating each weapon); +0x234 u8 (init 6, then from setup +0x11c; passed to each new weapon's slot 0x118)
external article holder (unnamed class: +0x238 ptr, +0x240 its own pool, +0x248, +0x258 u8 flag, +0x260 descriptor table)

notes: One class only (fighter). No export returns a field by a plain load: every getter walks the live-article ring (0x10..0x240) by kind, then calls into the Article (its boma at +0x8), so no field is 'certain'. ArticleOperationTarget: 0 = all matching, 1 = oldest, 2 = newest (ring walked from the end). Null-slot exports resolved from the export function: vtable offsets 0x78,0x80,0x90,0x98,0xa0,0xb8,0xc0,0xc8,0xd8,0xe8,0xf8,0x118,0x148 -> 0x71003d4180,0x71003d41e0,0x71003d4340,0x71003d4470,0x71003d45c0,0x71003d4790,0x71003d48b0,0x71003d49c0,0x71003d4bb0,0x71003d4d80,0x71003d4f50,0x71003d51f0,0x71003d5670 (generate_article, generate_article_enable, have, shoot, shoot_exist, change_motion, change_motion_from_no, add_motion_2nd, set_weight, add_motion_partial, set_frame_2nd, set_visibility_whole, set_flag). generate_article = generate (slot 0x70) then append to the ring (slot 0x1a0); generate_article_enable checks is_generatable (0x1d8) first. Slot 0x48 = clear (removes or deactivates every article, zeroes count/head/tail, clears pool and external holder). Slot 0x30 registers two callbacks in the object at owner_boma+0x18 then initialises the pool. Kinds at or beyond the own descriptor count go to the external holder at 0x248 (possibly articles borrowed from another fighter, e.g. copy abilities) - unverified.
